## One Complete Example

`[clean-room]` - original, not copied from any manual.

```basic
PROCEDURE grades
PARAM count: INTEGER
DIM score(20): INTEGER
DIM i, total: INTEGER
DIM avg: REAL

total = 0
FOR i = 1 TO count
  INPUT "Score: ", score(i)
  total = total + score(i)
NEXT i

avg = FLOAT(total) / FLOAT(count)
PRINT USING "'Average: ',R6.2", avg

IF avg >= 70.0 THEN
  PRINT "Class passes"
ELSE
